purpose: Phase-6C population-response prediction records. Each documents a labelled population prediction: the claim, its level, the single-cell source it is derived from, and its uncertainty. Population predictions are permitted ONLY where single-cell apoptosis evidence exists AND population evidence is absent.

pred_pop_b16bl6.claim: As the single (context-transferred) B16BL6 cell commits and executes apoptosis, a susceptible sub-population accumulates apoptosis while a resistant fraction and adapted/recovered survivors persist.
pred_pop_b16bl6.source_context: single_cell_apoptosis:B16BL6 (Phase 6B, itself a B16 -> B16BL6 transfer)
transfer_assumptions: surviving cells may adapt or recover
pred_pop_b16bl6.uncertainty: No B16BL6 population apoptosis dataset; fractions are schematic.

pred_pop_b16.claim: A susceptible B16 sub-population accumulates apoptosis while a resistant fraction persists; surviving cells may adapt/recover.
pred_pop_b16.uncertainty: No B16 population apoptotic-fraction dataset; fractions are schematic.
